fusions.name: Tossed Spoil
fusions.desc: Throws a link weighted with earth that deals 5 damage, with a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Grave Charge
fusions.desc: Primes up to 3 bodies in reach. Each bursts for 26 damage in 3.5 tiles, with 80% of that to the outer ring, the moment an enemy comes near it.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds. An escort of links fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep Footing
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
